app.name: Class & Routine
app.tagline: Your university routine, in one place.

emailBanner.title: Your email address is not working
emailBanner.body: We could not deliver mail to your address. Please give us a new university email.

profile.nameHint: Only a department admin can change your name.

photo.title: Photo
photo.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 2 MB.
photo.pending: Checking your photo. Your old photo stays until the check is done.
photo.rejected: That photo did not pass the safety check and was deleted. Please choose another.
photo.badType: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
photo.tooLarge: The photo must be 2 MB or smaller.

phone.title: Phone
phone.label: Phone number
phone.hint: Optional. A Bangladeshi mobile number, for example 01712345678. Only you can see it.

email.title: Change your email
email.hint: We send a link to the new address. Your old address stays in use until you open it.

confirmEmail.title: Confirming your new email
confirmEmail.done: Your email was changed. Sign in with the new address from now on.
confirmEmail.missing: The link is missing its code. Open the link from your email again.

home.title: Welcome
home.intro: The app is being set up. Features arrive step by step.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist.

rejected.title: Your registration was not approved
rejected.intro: Correct your department or short code below and apply again.
rejected.shortCodeHint: 1 to 10 letters, as in the routine sheet.

fieldError.department_id: Choose a department from the list.

registrations.title: Teacher registrations
registrations.reasonHint: 5 to 500 characters. The teacher will read it.

records.title: Teachers
records.confirmSuspend: Suspend {name}? They cannot sign in until you reactivate them.
records.confirmRemove: Remove {name}? Their history is kept and you can reactivate them later.

fieldError.short_code: Use 1 to 10 letters. TBA is reserved.
fieldError.full_name: Enter a name of 2 to 100 characters.

password.error: Use 8 to 128 characters with at least one letter and one number.

new_password.error: Use 8 to 128 characters with at least one letter and one number.

phone.error: Enter a Bangladeshi mobile number, for example 01712345678.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.emailHint: Use your university address, for example name@baiust.ac.bd.
signup.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number.
signup.departmentsUnavailable: The department list is not available yet.
signup.shortCodeHint: The 1 to 10 letter code used for you in the routine, for example SK.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: If the address can be used, we sent a message with the next step. The link works once and lasts 24 hours.

verify.title: Confirming your email
verify.expired: The link has expired or was already used. Enter your email and we will send a new one.
verify.resent: If that address needs confirming, a new link is on its way.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email
verifyEmail.body: Open the link we emailed you to continue. You can ask for a new link below.
verifyEmail.resent: A new link is on its way.

login.title: Sign in
login.wait: Too many tries. You can try again in {seconds} seconds.

secondStep.title: Second step
secondStep.body: Enter the 6 digit code from your authenticator app.
secondStep.emailSent: We emailed you a code. It works once and lasts 10 minutes.

totp.title: Set up your authenticator app
totp.body: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app, then enter the 6 digit code it shows.
totp.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
totp.manualKey: Or type this key into the app:

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.body: Enter your university email. If there is an account, we will send a link that lasts 1 hour.
forgot.sent: If the account exists, we sent a link. Check your email.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new one.
reset.missing: This reset link is not valid. Ask for a new one.

changePassword.title: Account
changePassword.heading: Change your password
changePassword.done: Your password was changed. Other devices were signed out.

holding.joinBody: Your email is confirmed. The form to join your section is coming soon.
holding.waitingBody: Your request is waiting for approval. We will email you when it is decided.
holding.updateBody: A new semester has started. The semester update form is coming soon.

departments.title: Departments
departments.name: Name
departments.retireConfirm: Retire {code}? It disappears from sign-up and the join form, but its history stays.
departments.codeHint: 2 to 10 capital letters, for example CSE.

admins.title: Admins
admins.warning: Fewer than two super admins exist. Add another so the university is never locked out.
admins.searchHint: Type at least 2 letters. Only active accounts with a verified email are listed.
admins.removeConfirm: Remove this role from {name}? They are signed out at once.
admins.resetPasswordDone: A reset link was sent to {name}.
admins.resetSecondStepDone: {name} will set up the second step again at the next sign-in.

semesters.title: Semesters
semesters.name: Name

semesters.bootstrapHint: This is the first semester, so it can be made current directly. Later semesters use the rollover.

fieldError.name: Enter a name.
fieldError.end_date: The end date must be after the start date.

classrooms.title: Classrooms
classrooms.codeHint: 1 to 20 characters, for example 311 or LR-407B.

classrooms.sharedWithMeEmpty: No other department shares a room with you.

fieldError.department_ids: Choose active departments other than the owner.

imports.publishBody: Students and teachers will see the new routine.
